gen-dafont-lemon-milk-gf-esteban: Lemon Milk spaces its rounded letters wide and draws them with one unvarying pen line, friendly and hard to miss. And Esteban, a classic serif, thins its strokes just slightly and lets its oversized lowercase do the quiet work.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-gf-faustina: Faustina is a classic serif whose strokes taper modestly and whose c opens its jaws like a pair of pliers. Faustina handles the steady reading, while Lemon Milk brings loose, rounded, rolling-pen letters to the headline.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-gf-halant: Tall, sturdy lowercase and outward-pointing terminals give Halant a traditional, carpenter-pencil authority. Halant carries a faint pen-like thick-thin shift against Lemon Milk's wide-tracked, neon-tube roundness, and that gap is the whole charm.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-gf-hedvig-letters-: Hedvig Letters Serif is a classic serif with a tall, sturdy lowercase and curves left open to breathe. But Lemon Milk above it, drawn as if with a single nib, stays wide-spaced and round, so the two feel deliberately unlike.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-gf-marcellus-sc: Friendly is the first word for Lemon Milk, its wide-set rounded letters moving like a marker that ignores direction. Marcellus SC, a text serif with pulled-back terminals and gentle modulation, can be sized up a touch so its stature shows.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-gf-noto-serif-hent: Constant-width lines in wide, rounded letters make Lemon Milk instantly striking and friendly. But Noto Serif Hentaigana is the real contrast, a serif whose smooth, modest weight gradient and open curves give the pair its refined character.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-gf-ovo: Ovo keeps its serif strokes restrained, with thins only slightly lighter than thicks and a tall middle band. And Lemon Milk, wire-like and wide-tracked, supplies the rounded friendliness that makes that restraint feel welcoming.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-manrope: Approachable describes both fonts, though in different ways: Lemon Milk is wide and rounded, one pen line throughout. Manrope, a sans with bright openings at every curve and a minimal step from capitals to lowercase, keeps that same friendliness in text.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-satoshi: Approachable and quietly confident, Satoshi stands on a soaring x-height and a generously opened e, every stroke cut to one width. Lemon Milk does the striking, and Satoshi does the reading.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-work-sans: Modern in feel, Work Sans keeps its c tips well apart and its mean line set high. Work Sans handles the text with that contemporary clarity, while Lemon Milk makes the headline wide, round and friendly.
